race.title: JCB Triumph Trial Juvenile Hurdle (Registered As The Prestbury Juvenile Hurdle) (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
race.verdict: James Owen has won 2 of the last 3 renewals and has a good chance of adding to that tally with CHARLES DARNAY , who looks another very useful juvenile for connections after his listed win at Wetherby. Irish challengers Atomic City and Admiral Will Brown were both impressive when making winning debuts in this sphere so rate as serious threats. CHARLES DARNAY ATOMIC CITY (IRE) ADMIRAL WILL BROWN
race.bettingForecast: Charles Darnay (13/8), Atomic City (5/2), Admiral Will Brown (5/1), Magnetude (8/1), Don Dandy (10/1), Mix Match (10/1), Confused (33/1), Electrical (66/1), Tiny Riot (66/1)
